_what_this_is: The development configuration, used when neither $URDS_AGENT_CONFIG nor %ProgramData%\URDS\agent.json exists. install.ps1 writes a real one pointing at the user's own folders; this one points inside the checkout so that running the agent from a clone can never touch anything outside it. Relative paths here are anchored to the repository root, not the working directory.
_blast_radius: protected_paths is the whole blast radius. The agent suspends a process only for a write inside one of these roots. agent/config.py refuses a filesystem root, and refuses any path overlapping the Windows, Program Files or common Unix system directories - before the responder exists, not after it has acted.
_allowlist_images: Process images permitted to write to a canary without being suspended. Empty by design: an allowlist that ships with entries is an allowlist nobody has read. Add full image paths only, and only with a reason in the commit message.
_attribution_timeout_ms: How long the correlator waits for the Security-log subscription to name the writer of a path. The live run measured 0.158 ms to attribution; this is the ceiling before the answer degrades to UNKNOWN and the responder isolates rather than terminates.
